title: correctedLocation
responsibility: Resolves helper names and entity categories at the viewed revision; omits helper owners only when their callable name is unambiguous.

inputs.name: correctedLocation.at
inputs.description: The address of the entity at the viewed revision, including its category and optional helper. Its category and entity select the correction path; `platforms` always returns null.

inputs.name: correctedLocation.entities
inputs.description: Entries for entities listed at the viewed revision, matched by `id` and `category`; each may omit `unit`. Helper correction considers a unit only when its `helpers` contains a matching name.

inputs.name: compactHelperLocation.at
inputs.description: The address to compact. It is eligible only when its category is `functions` and both `helper` and `entity` are present.

inputs.name: compactHelperLocation.entities
inputs.description: Full explorer entities at the viewed revision. Only function entities whose unit lists a helper with the exact requested name can establish ownership.

outputs.name: correctedLocation
outputs.description: An address with its category changed to the listed entity category, or with the sole matching owner added for a function helper without an entity. Returns null when no correction applies, including for `platforms`, an absent entity, or zero or multiple helper owners.

outputs.name: compactHelperLocation
outputs.description: An explorer address with `entity` omitted only when exactly one function entity owns the named helper and it is the current entity. In every other case, the input address is returned unchanged.
